extension_action_title.description: The tooltip of the toolbar button.

extension_activity_count_some.description: Count of the entries that match the search.

extension_activity_empty.description: Shown when Imp has done nothing yet.

extension_activity_found.description: Start of a line: Imp found something on a page. The searched words follow.

extension_activity_help.message: When Imp reads a page or looks for something on one, it shows up here.
extension_activity_help.description: Help for the list of what Imp just did.

extension_activity_list_label.description: Accessible name of the full list.

extension_activity_looked_for.description: Start of a line: Imp looked for something on a page and did not find it. The searched words follow.

extension_activity_no_match.description: Shown when the search finds nothing.

extension_activity_read.description: A line: Imp read a page.

extension_activity_read_failed.description: A line: Imp could not read a page.

extension_activity_search.description: Placeholder of the search box over the full list.

extension_activity_search_label.description: Accessible name of the search box over the full list.

extension_activity_see_all.description: Button that opens the whole list. The number is how many entries there are.

extension_activity_title.description: Title of the list of what Imp just did in the browser.

extension_ago_hours.description: How long ago: a number of hours, as short as possible.

extension_ago_minutes.description: How long ago: a number of minutes, as short as possible.

extension_ago_now.description: How long ago something happened: just now.

extension_ago_seconds.description: How long ago: a number of seconds, as short as possible.

extension_back.description: Button that goes back to the first screen of the popup.

extension_description.message: Lets Imp know which page you are on and where things are on it. Talks only to Imp on this computer.
extension_description.description: The extension description in the browser store and extension list.

extension_help.description: Label of the small question mark button that opens a help tip.

extension_imp_asleep.description: Accessible name of an Imp that is asleep.

extension_imp_away.description: Accessible name of an Imp that is on another device.

extension_imp_device_default.description: Name of the phone an Imp is on when it did not say which.

extension_imp_fallback.description: Accessible name of an Imp that has no name.

extension_imp_working.description: Accessible name of an Imp that is working.

extension_imp_working_away.description: Accessible name of an Imp that is working on another device.

extension_offline_body.message: Start Imp on this computer and this connects by itself.
extension_offline_body.description: Shown when Imp is not running: what to do.

extension_offline_title.description: Title shown when Imp is not running.

extension_open.description: Button that opens the Imp app.

extension_open_help.message: Opens the Imp app. It starts Imp if it is not running.
extension_open_help.description: Help for the button that opens the Imp app.

extension_private.description: Note that nothing leaves the computer.

extension_reconnect.description: Button that tries to reach Imp again.

extension_reconnect_help.message: Looks for Imp again. Use it after you start Imp.
extension_reconnect_help.description: Help for the button that tries to reach Imp again.

extension_status_checking.description: Connection status while the extension looks for Imp.

extension_status_connected.description: Connection status when Imp is reachable.

extension_status_connected_browser.description: Connection status when Imp is reachable, with the name of the browser.

extension_status_connecting.description: Connection status while a connection attempt runs.

extension_status_not_connected.description: Connection status when Imp cannot be reached.

extension_tab_blind.message: The browser keeps this page to itself. Imp only knows its address.
extension_tab_blind.description: Help for the page box when the browser keeps the page private.

extension_tab_label.description: Accessible name of the box that shows the page you are on.

extension_tab_sees.message: Imp can read this page and find things on it when it needs to.
extension_tab_sees.description: Help for the page box when Imp can look inside the page.

extension_tab_untitled.description: Name of a page that has no title.
